name: IRBESARTAN / AMLODIPINE 150MG/5MG 14 TABLETS
description: Irbesartan controls high blood pressure, but it does not cure the condition. It may take up to 2 weeks before you feel the full benefit of irbesartan. Continue taking irbesartan even if you feel well. Do not stop taking the medication without first consulting your doctor. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
